title: ADE / Honeywell Accenta G4 · 8EP417A LCD
baseline: IU1-0040 Rev1.0 User Guide + IE1-0040 Rev1.1 Engineer Manual, combined original manufacturer booklet. Accenta G4 LCD baseline; no G3 or built-in Optima compact LED menu substitution.
scope: Full documented LCD engineer tree, user1/user2 programming, day/chime and already-authorised setting/unsetting contexts. Reference-only LED presentation and physical/system effects are labelled.

sources.title: Accenta/Optima User Guide and Accenta G4 Engineer’s Manual
sources.pageNumbering: User: PDF 1–24, printed Arabic page +4. Engineer: PDF 25–80, printed Arabic page +28.
sources.scope: Original manufacturer booklet in a third-party archive. Accenta G4 with 8EP417A LCD keypad; the LED/Optima compact variations are distinguished. Revision footers are on PDF24 and PDF80.

numbering.style: Local single digits plus CHIME/OMIT/PROG letter shortcuts
numbering.explanation: Choose each menu level separately. Most numeric choices enter immediately; engineer menu8 uses8 thenSET as printed, while user8 is immediate. C means CHIME, O means OMIT and P means PROG. Address dots are FINDR breadcrumbs, not a single concatenated hotkey.
caveats: No menu5 exists at the engineer root in IE1-0040 Rev1.1.
Flag and exit-mode values are not nested menus.
One physical ▲ key browses forward; there is no ▼ key on the 8EP417A.

navigation.action: A local digit enters a numbered menu; engineer8 requires SET as its source states. ▲ browses forward; SET selects; RESET returns. Editing rules differ by screen.
Engineer shortcuts to Event Log / Omit Allow and Double Knock / Set Up Programs. In other contexts the same keys perform the documented local action.

nodes.label: Test Outputs

nodes.summary: FINDR context representing the moment after an authorised user code has started setting. It does not add a keypad menu.

nodes.label: Program 1 Set
nodes.summary: OMIT selects zones to omit; PROG selects program 1/2/3. SET quick-sets. Timing is condensed in the simulator.

nodes.label: Omit Zones
nodes.summary: Only Used + Omit Allow zones can be omitted. A zone digit marks it omitted for this set period; SET continues setting. Unsetting automatically restores omitted zones.
notes: The manual does not explicitly document pressing a zone digit again to reinstate; this emulator makes omission idempotent. The precise ▲ behaviour in this procedure needs physical verification.

nodes.label: Select Program
nodes.summary: Select 1, 2 or 3 during the exit procedure. Disabled programs cannot be selected.

nodes.label: Program 1
nodes.summary: Setting program selection.

nodes.label: Program 2
nodes.summary: Setting program selection.

nodes.label: Program 3
nodes.summary: Setting program selection.

nodes.label: User Unsetting
nodes.summary: FINDR context for the documented four-digit user-code gesture. Any four fictional practice digits complete unsetting; real and factory credentials are neither requested nor validated.

nodes.label: Unset System
nodes.summary: Enter any four fictional practice digits. Successful unsetting automatically restores every temporary omitted zone; no live authentication is performed.

gaps.title: Flag2 SET wording conflict
gaps.question: Does SET save, toggle, or depend on selection stage in Flag2 on this firmware?
gaps.reason: Engineer p23 first says digits or SET toggle, then explicitly says SET saves and RESET leaves; the same page diagram and p21 also use SET to save. The emulator follows the repeated save instruction and uses digits to toggle.
gaps.neededEvidence: A source-matched keypad recording of Flag2 selection, SET and RESET.

gaps.title: Physical keypad comparison
gaps.question: Can an 8EP417A on Accenta G4 be checked against these specific manual revisions?
gaps.reason: The menu tree is pinned to original printed sources; LCD spacing, key-repeat, beeps and firmware variation have not been measured on hardware.
gaps.neededEvidence: A consented video of the relevant menu operations with panel and software version visible.

gaps.title: Omission arrow behaviour
gaps.question: Does ▲ only browse, or also omit, in the LCD user omission screen?
gaps.reason: User p6 says zone number or up arrow to be omitted, without a clear separate browse/toggle description. The emulator uses digits to omit and ▲ to browse, and never asserts repeated-digit reinstatement.
gaps.neededEvidence: A short keypad recording showing ▲ and repeating the same zone digit during omission.

gaps.title: Bell time zero conflict
gaps.question: Does 00 mean continuous on this precise revision?
gaps.reason: Engineer p25 gives 01–99 minutes; summary p52 gives 00–99 and specifications p46 mention continuous, without explicitly assigning 00. The editable range is conservatively 01–99.
gaps.neededEvidence: Manufacturer clarification or G4 firmware-specific keypad evidence for 00.

gaps.title: Exit-time diagram typo
gaps.question: Confirm menu5 for exit time on hardware.
gaps.reason: Engineer p39 LCD prose, p34 structure and p52 summary identify Exit Time as5; a p39 diagram/LED instruction wrongly repeats4. The emulator follows the mutually corroborated LCD route5.

gaps.title: Duress permission conflict
gaps.question: Confirm user1 cannot program duress in this baseline.
gaps.reason: Engineer p28 introductory text is inconsistent with User Guide p13, which explicitly restricts duress setup/edit/delete to engineer programming. The user roots follow the restrictive, explicit user-guide rule.
gaps.neededEvidence: Hardware permission check or corrected manufacturer manual.

gaps.title: Omit-allow default conflict
gaps.question: Which factory omission eligibility applies to the actual firmware?
gaps.reason: Engineer p31 says all zones enabled as Omit Allow; the LED notes on p33 say default off. No factory-default claim is made; all initial settings are labelled FINDR fixtures.
gaps.neededEvidence: Corrected manufacturer defaults table or firmware-specific record.

gaps.title: Physical and signalling effects
gaps.question: Which physical demonstrations would you like verified next?
gaps.reason: No live bell, communicator, PA, tamper, timed rearm, entry countdown or ARC is connected. LEDs, sounds and generated events are illustrative local feedback.
gaps.neededEvidence: Controlled hardware comparison for the exact system variant.

coverage.strategy: Menu-by-menu transcription of both pinned original sections, backed by family-specific runtime behaviour and source-conflict records.
mappedAreas: All3 program trees and mask dependencies
Time/date, library zone names, timers, codes
LCD log controls and message appendix
Omission, restoration on unset and chime
excludedAreas: Actual PA, bell or communicator transport
Measured timing, LCD character spacing and original tone synthesis
coverage.confidence: High for the printed menu tree; explicit qualifications for documented conflicts, omission arrow behaviour and physical timing.
